sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:23

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:23:1
items.html: On the first Shabbat the Nukva returned to be corrected in all the six phases mentioned above, and the sixth phase was completed, that she returned with him face to face in all the measure of his level, except the discernment of the Keter. The intention is to the seven phases that he reckons above: three phases in back to back and four phases in face to face, which are seven phases. And the sixth phase is the Partzuf of the Mochin of Haya that he receives from AVI, when the Nukva ascends in an equal level with ZA and they clothe AVI. However, since the inclusion of NH is not in the place of the Netzah but in the place of the Hod, therefore only the Sefira of the Netzah is reckoned as a root for the Nukva, and she does not reach the Tifferet of Ima, which is the Keter of ZA; rather she needs to receive all her abundance from ZA, who is the discernment of Netzah, as above. See there. And therefore she needs him, and his Keter is higher than her Keter. And she is found lacking the seventh phase mentioned above.
